title: ICS Awarded Multimillion Dollar Contract  For 28-Cell Cooling Tower At New Petronas Refinery In Malaysia
text: Colorado-Based ICS Wins Major Cooling Tower Project in Malaysia Multimillion dollar 28-cell cooling tower part of $16 billion Malaysian refinery complex Lakewood, Colo., June 15, 2015 – Lakewood, Colorado-based Industrial Cooling Solutions (ICS) announced that it has been awarded a contract to build a multimillion dollar 28-cell cooling tower at the RAPID Steam Cracker Complex Project in Johor, Malaysia. ICS was awarded the contract by Japan-based Toyo Engineering Corporation (TEC) and its consortium partner, Thailand-based TTCL Public Company Limited (TTCL). The Cracker Complex is a part of the massive $16 billion RAPID petrochemical complex being built by the Malaysian state-owned energy company, Petronas. Tim Bozic, President of ICS, said, “The fact that TEC and TTCL selected us for this landmark project, with the contract ratified by Petronas, is a testament to our record of global engineering excellence in complex cooling tower design and supply projects. We at ICS are thrilled and honored to have been recognized in this manner.” ICS has successfully completed cooling tower projects for TTCL and TEC in multiple countries and this multimillion dollar award represents the company’s largest single-site cooling tower to date. The concrete, back-to-back counterflow cooling tower will play a critical role in the development of the state-of-the-art RAPID refinery by reducing power use while maintaining optimum plant efficiency for maximum production output. The RAPID integrated refinery and petrochemical complex is currently scheduled to begin operating in 2019 and will add capacity to allow Petronas to better meet strong demand for refined petroleum. About Industrial Cooling Solutions, Inc. Industrial Cooling Solutions, Inc. (ICS) utilizes cutting-edge technology to provide turnkey water cooling management solutions nationally and internationally. The company’s products and services include the installation, repair and upgrade of custom-designed water cooling towers, as well as the provision of water treatment and filtration supplies and a full spectrum of cooling tower parts. ICS’s international headquarters are located in Lakewood, Colorado, while the company serves its global network through offices in Thailand, Japan, and Saudi Arabia. For more information please go to https://h2ocooling.com/ or contact ICS at 303-462-2000. # # #
